parsed.rationale: Although `StreamingService.name` (Metadata package, line 20) and `MusicServiceIdentifier.displayName` (MusicShareKit package, line 76) share a high Jaccard similarity of 0.875, they are computed properties on two structurally and semantically distinct types in separate packages. `StreamingService` models a streaming service entity, while `MusicServiceIdentifier` is an identifier type inside a music-sharing model. The differing names (`name` vs `displayName`) and their distinct domain roles suggest the structural similarity is coincidental rather than a sign of unintended duplication. Merging or extracting them would couple two otherwise independent packages without clear benefit.
